name: 🚀 LeadGen Engine — AI-Powered Lead Generation & Nurturing (95 nodes)

parameters.content:
# 🔍 INTENT RADAR
### AI-Powered Buying Signal Detection

**Scans Reddit (via Google), Twitter & RSS every 15min for buying intent.**
No Reddit API = No ToS violation. Read-only monitoring.

`Keywords: "looking for", "need help with", "switching from", "alternative to"`

# 🧬 LEAD DNA — Deep Enrichment
### Transforms a username into a complete buyer profile

**Modular enrichment: works with or without paid APIs.**
Apollo.io → Email, Company, LinkedIn | Fallback → Google Search (free)
AI Profiler builds: Persona, Pain Points, Best Approach

`Score = Intent(40%) + Fit(30%) + Engagement(20%) + Timing(10%)`

# ⚖️ MULTI-LLM CONSENSUS
### GPT-4o strategizes · Claude 3.5 writes · GPT-mini validates

**HOT leads (80+): Triple AI filter for surgical precision**
WARM leads: Single fast model (GPT-4o-mini)

`Quality Gate REJECTS: spammy, generic, too long, or AI-sounding messages`

# 🛑 HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP
### Every message reviewed by a human before sending

**Slack #lead-review with Approve / Edit / Reject buttons**
AI assists, humans decide. Zero unsupervised auto-send.
Timeout: 4h for HOT, 24h for WARM → auto-archive (never auto-send)

# 📤 PREMIUM OUTREACH + CONVERSION FUNNEL
### Email auto-sends (after warm-up) · Reddit/LinkedIn = human-sent

**Warm emails only. Max 30/day. Random 45-120s delay. No tracking pixels.**
Conversion: Reply analysis → Calendly link → Demo booked 🎉

`Footer: "If this isn't relevant, let me know and I won't follow up."`

# 🔄 SMART NURTURE + 📉 WARMTH DECAY
### Scores decay 10%/day of inactivity. Treats leads like people.

**Day 0: 85 (HOT) → Day 3: 62 (WARM) → Day 7: 40 (COLD) → Day 14: auto-archive**
Re-engagement resets score. Email open slows decay. Reply = boost +20.
AI decides: WAIT / FOLLOW_UP / CHANGE_CHANNEL / ARCHIVE

`Not a dumb drip sequence — an adaptive system that respects buying cycles`

# 🛡️ COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE
### Monitors competitor complaints on Reddit

**Finds people ready to switch. Detects negative sentiment.**
High-opportunity leads auto-enter the enrichment pipeline.

# 📊 COMMAND CENTER
### Weekly AI-powered pipeline report

**Full visibility: leads/day, conversion rates, cost/lead, top keywords.**
AI generates insights + predictions. Slack #lead-analytics.

# 👻 SHADOW MODE — Validation Layer
### Runs in parallel without sending. Compares AI vs Human.

**2 weeks of silent validation before going live.**
AI drafts messages, human responds manually, GPT compares both.

`"Ran Shadow Mode on 50 leads. AI matched my responses at 92.4%."`

# ❌ GLOBAL ERROR HANDLER
### Catches all failures · Logs to Airtable · Alerts via Slack

**CRITICAL → pause workflow | WARNING → alert + continue | INFO → log only**

# 📊 LIVE RESULTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Week 1: 52 detected → 14 enriched → 6 contacted → 2 replies → 1 demo
Week 2: 67 detected → 19 enriched → 8 contacted → 3 replies → 1 demo
Week 3: 71 detected → 22 enriched → 11 contacted → 4 replies → 2 demos
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
**Total: 190 leads | 36% reply rate | $0.43/lead | 4 demos booked**

👻 Shadow Mode accuracy: **92.4%** match vs human responses
💰 Total cost: **$7-15/month**

_5 Quality Gates: Shadow Mode · Multi-LLM · HITL · Quality Gate · Warmth Decay_
